name: Church Missionary Society, The
title: Church Missionary Society, The
---

This was an important missionary society, founded in 1799, whose supporters came from the Evangelical wing of the Church of England.

Its archives 1799-1959 are held by the University of Birmingham and have been partly published on microfilm.

The organisation still exists and is called the Church Mission Society.
